optimizer.title: A Smoother Path to Outperformance with Multi-Factor Smart Beta
optimizer.screen_note: Diversification-based blending = implicit regularization. 2nd-order (mean-variance correlation). Top priority: directly addresses our multi-sleeve combination problem.

optimizer.title: Cost and Capacity: Comparing Smart Beta Strategies
optimizer.screen_note: Capacity-adjusted weighting = implicit regularization. Cost-aware 2nd-order optimization. Directly supports our 15bps turnover constraint framework.

optimizer.title: Self-Consistent Adjoint Policy Iteration for Constrained Dynamic Portfolio Choice
optimizer.screen_note: Simulation-based constrained optimization via HJB/adjoint. 50-asset validated, CRRA + convex constraints. Applicable to our 25-stock long-only problem. No shrinkage but avoids tail estimation.

optimizer.title: Scalable Pontryagin-Guided Adjoint Control for Constrained Dynamic Portfolio Choice
optimizer.screen_note: Scales adjoint optimization to 100 assets (nRMSE<8.5e-3). Companion to 2608.17808. 25-stock universe well within scope. Pair both for comprehensive review.

optimizer.title: Entropic Value-at-Risk Portfolio Optimization for Tempered Stable Levy Processes
optimizer.screen_note: EVaR tighter than CVaR. Parametric CGF structure gives weak shrinkage. Tail-quantile statistic. Higher Sharpe than CVaR benchmark (rolling US ETF 2000-2026). 후순위 due to tail estimation.

optimizer.title: Dynamic Portfolio Optimization under CVaR Constraints
optimizer.screen_note: Continuous-time CVaR constraint. Elegant HJB formulation. No shrinkage + tail statistic. Discretization for monthly rebalance is non-trivial. Theoretical reference.

risk.title: The Reconfiguration Premium: Co-movement Structure as an Unspanned Dimension of the VRP
risk.relevance: Measures rate-of-change in cross-sectional co-movement structure (principal angles between eigenspaces of consecutive correlation matrices). Priced in aggregate VRP (t=5.40). Implication: incorporate correlation stability metric in risk model update frequency and crowding monitor.

risk.title: The Markets Conditioning Representation: Crowding and Convention Multiplicity
risk.relevance: Formalizes representation crowding (driver-space overlap among strategies) vs. position crowding. Empirical driver-specific crowding signature. Directly enhances our crowding risk model (CR05_Short_Pressure_Proxy, CR04_Institutional_Overlap).

risk.title: Regime-Gated Residual Mixture-of-Experts for Cross-Sectional Volatility Forecasting
risk.relevance: RG-ResMoE for 5-day realized vol forecasting. Regime-gated hard routing outperforms soft routing and capacity-matched MLP. US + Japan validation. Enhances our D-family (D03/D34) realized vol estimates. No shrinkage + 2nd-order = ⭐

risk.title: Rough Volatility Across Assets
risk.relevance: Hurst H~0.13 across 3926 US equities. Rough vol universal. KR: incorporate roughness correction in realized variance estimator for risk model. Fractional moment = higher-order = ⭐

risk.title: A Generic Nonparametric Value-at-Risk Estimator for High Dimensions
risk.relevance: Nonparametric VaR+CVaR algorithm for arbitrary dimensions. 500 portfolios x 49 futures test. Risk measurement reference. No shrinkage + tail = 후순위 for optimizer coupling.

risk.title: Social Disclosure Channels and Firm Risk
risk.relevance: First-time DART social disclosure -> increased idiosyncratic vol. Continuous sustainability reporting -> lower vol. Potential idiosyncratic risk predictor if DART NLP pipeline built.

risk.title: Ignored Risks of Factor Investing
risk.relevance: Factor crash risk and hidden tail risks in factor portfolios. Direct input for risk-research tail stress diagnostics. Reference framework for momentum crash / value trap risks.

risk.title: No Silver Bullets in Investing
risk.relevance: Risk premia framing and implementation caution. Factor premia persistence and decay context. Background reading for risk model validation.

regime.title: Trend-Following: What Is Not to Like?
regime.relevance: Comprehensive trend-following analysis including crisis alpha properties. Reference for overlay regime signal construction.

regime.title: The Convexity of Trend Following
regime.relevance: Analyzes the convex (option-like) payoff of trend strategies in tail events. Supports crisis alpha overlay design.

regime.title: Timing Smart Beta Strategies
regime.relevance: Relative valuation approach to factor timing. Buy when cheap, sell when expensive. Supports regime-conditional factor allocation (RCMA) design.

regime.title: Winton UCITS Funds ICAV Prospectus 2025
regime.relevance: Winton systematic strategy taxonomy across trend, carry, relative value. Implementation constraints and risk management reference.

regime.title: Winton Managed Futures Trend Fund Prospectus 2025
regime.relevance: Managed futures trend process and implementation constraints. Reference for crisis alpha overlay mechanics.
